text:
sam.release: deploybot blocked staging->prod for release/2026.03.21 :warning:

sam.release: observed reason: eu registry manifestlist published but arm64 submanifest missing cosign attestation — deploybot held promotion.

deploy-bot: [automated] promotion-check FAILED for image eu.gcr.redwood/release/2026.03.21:manifestlist
```
error: provenance-check: submanifest arch=arm64 missing signature/annotation 'cosign-attestation'
action: hold promotion, notify #eng-infra
```

maria.prod: ack. we had a flaky arm64 job earlier in staging CI, could be related.

jun.infra: checking logs — arm64 push succeeded but cosign upload errored with HTTP 503 to timestamp-verifier.

jun.infra: cosign output:
```
cosign upload --key kms://proj/... --payload manifest-arm64.json
Error: 503 service unavailable: timestamp-verifier
```

tony.oncall: can we re-sign just the arm64 submanifest instead of full rebuild? minimal blast radius during change window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jun.infra: yes — we can rerun cosign sign on the arm64 manifest digest and attach attestation. registry index needs a small republish to reference signed blob. deploybot has a republish-submanifest flow but runs in staging by default.

maria.prod: tradeoffs? re-sign is fast but leaves a short inconsistency until index updated. full rebuild is clean but exceeds our 30m change window.

sam.release: proposal: targeted re-sign + deploybot republish-submanifest in staging, quick canary sanity, then promote. fallback: pin to previous digest if issues.

tony.oncall: agree. I'll monitor. rollback criteria: error rate spike >5% or latency 2x baseline for 5m.

jiun.infra: (typo) jun.infra: starting targeted re-sign, will use staging cosign key and then request manual override for prod republish after sanity.

ci-bot: queued job #4587: republish-submanifest (arch=arm64) triggered by jun.infra.

deploy-bot: [manual] republish-submanifest started: job=4587 target=eu.gcr.redwood/release/2026.03.21 arch=arm64

jun.infra: need Maria to sign off on a short release note update documenting the targeted republish and pinned rollback digest.

maria.prod: updating release notes: "Hotfix: republished arm64 attestation for release/2026.03.21 — no functional changes." rollback digest: `sha256:af12deadbeefc0ffee1234567890abcdcdef1234567890abcdefabcdefabcd`. PR: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/1024

deploy-bot: republish-submanifest completed SUCCESS. cosign attestation now present for arm64.

deploy-bot: re-running promotion-check... OK. promotion allowed under canary->gradual rollout policy.

sam.release: promoting canary to 10% now. prod tag unchanged; pinned digest noted in release notes.

tony.oncall: monitoring; adding temporary alert for arm64-specific regressions. :eyes:

maria.prod: changelog + release notes pushed.

jun.infra: postmortem action: add retry/backoff for cosign timestamp-verifier and surface per-arch provenance status earlier in CI. filing INFRA-7843.

sam.release: :thumbsup: will keep thread open until canary reaches 30% or rollback criteria hit.
